# x86 in 16-bit mode (`.code16`, in a 32-bit object), AT&T syntax: one instruction per line, checked against
# GNU as by tools/gas-diff/run.sh, which picks the mode and syntax from this
# file's name.
#
# The sections walk the general-purpose instruction set with every operand
# size and addressing form the mode has, then x87 and a sample of SIMD. The
# same cases are in tools/mc-diff/i8086.txt, checked against llvm-mc.
# A commented-out case is one where rsasm follows llvm-mc rather than GNU as;
# the GNU as answer is given beside it.
# ---- addressing: every ModRM form of the mode, through mov -----------------
mov (%bx,%si), %ax
mov %cl, (%bx,%si)
mov (%bx,%di), %ax
mov %cl, (%bx,%di)
mov (%bp,%si), %ax
mov %cl, (%bp,%si)
mov (%bp,%di), %ax
mov %cl, (%bp,%di)
mov (%si), %ax
mov %cl, (%si)
mov (%di), %ax
mov %cl, (%di)
mov (%bp), %ax
mov %cl, (%bp)
mov (%bx), %ax
mov %cl, (%bx)
mov 4(%bx,%si), %ax
mov %cl, 4(%bx,%si)
mov -2(%bp), %ax
mov %cl, -2(%bp)
mov 0x1234(%di), %ax
mov %cl, 0x1234(%di)
mov 0x1234, %dl
mov 0x1234, %edx

# ---- addressing: the other address size, with 0x67 -------------------------
mov (%ebx), %eax
lea (%ebx), %ax
mov 8(%esi), %eax
lea 8(%esi), %ax
mov 4(%edx,%edi,4), %eax
lea 4(%edx,%edi,4), %ax
mov (%esp), %eax
lea (%esp), %ax
mov (%ebp), %eax
lea (%ebp), %ax

# ---- addressing: segment overrides, and the ones left out as redundant -----
movb %es:(%bx), %al
movb %al, %es:(%bp)
movb %cs:(%bx), %al
movb %al, %cs:(%bp)
movb %ss:(%bx), %al
movb %al, %ss:(%bp)
movb %ds:(%bx), %al
movb %al, %ds:(%bp)
movb %fs:(%bx), %al
movb %al, %fs:(%bp)
movb %gs:(%bx), %al
movb %al, %gs:(%bp)
movl %fs:0x10, %eax
movw %gs:0x10, %ax
movb %es:0x10, %al
fs movw (%bx), %ax

# ---- accumulator moves to and from an absolute address ---------------------
mov 0x1000, %al
mov %al, 0x1000
mov 0x1000, %ax
mov %ax, 0x1000
mov 0x1000, %eax
mov %eax, 0x1000

# ---- operand sizes: 8, 16 and 32 bits --------------------------------------
mov %bl, %al
mov %bl, (%bx,%di)
mov (%bx,%di), %bl
mov $18, %al
movb $127, (%bx,%di)
mov %bx, %ax
mov %bx, (%bx,%di)
mov (%bx,%di), %bx
mov $18, %ax
movw $127, (%bx,%di)
mov %ebx, %eax
mov %ebx, (%bx,%di)
mov (%bx,%di), %ebx
mov $18, %eax
movl $127, (%bx,%di)
